name: Mystic Jumper
detailed_description:
A whimsical pixel-art platformer where a clumsy wizard miscasts a spell, turning himself into random objects like a crate, chair, and barrel. Now trapped at the bottom of his own magical tower, he must triple-jump his way to the top to fix his mistake. Navigate tricky platforming challenges, dodge hazards, and master unique object physics in this charming adventure!

Features:

  • Triple-Jump Mechanic – Master precise jumps with a unique triple-jump system.

  • Object Transformation – Play as different objects with their own physics.

  • Challenging Platforming – Climb a dangerous tower filled with traps and moving platforms.

  • Retro Pixel-Art Style – A nostalgic aesthetic inspired by classic platformers.

  • Mystical Atmosphere – Explore a magical tower with glowing runes and enchanted backgrounds.

    Controls (keyboard, mouse, gamepad): 

    Jump Left: Q, A, Left arrow, gamepad left, gamepad X button, or mouse click on a left side of the game screen.

    Jump Right: E, D, Right arrow, gamepad right, gamepad B button, or mouse click on a right side of the game screen.

    Jump Up: W, S, Up arrow, gamepad up, gamepad Y button, or mouse click on a top half part of the game screen.

    Restart level: R, gamepad's Select button.

    Pause: Esc, P, gamepad's Start button.

    Menu selection: Enter, spacebar, gamepad's A or B buttons.
